title: Test user journeys: Model a complete interaction as state transitions with preconditions, visible success and failure states
description: React 19 and TypeScript 5 guide to test user journeys with reproducible starter bugs, instructor corrections, local regression assertions and browser-verification boundaries.
objectives: Model a complete interaction as state transitions with preconditions, visible success and failure states.
Repair the intentionally failing example for test user journeys.
Distinguish a server-rendered assertion from genuine browser behavior and integration evidence.
rubric: I can explain the difference between a static fixture and a mounted test for test user journeys.
I can repair the starter for 06.05.03 and demonstrate the regression assertion.
I can describe the necessary browser, dependency or profiler evidence before claiming production reliability.
